comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 needs a counter-argument against the OP's view that cites a concrete empirical example (a case, event, study, statistic or documented observation). Non-numeric real-world cases count. Feature 1 needs specific numerical data or statistics in any comment, with no requirement of a counter-argument, and it explicitly excludes non-quantitative examples. Each can be 1 when the other is 0: a historical case with no numbers gives 0 on feature 1, and a figure in a non-counter comment gives 0 on feature 0. They are different extraction functions.
